caption: The drawing consists of several distinct objects arranged within a rectangular border on a plain background. At the top are eight small, individual gold and brown items featuring intricate patterns; these appear to be clasps or fasteners, with some showing rounded, rectangular, or hook-like shapes. Below them to the left are two larger gold and brown ornamental pieces; one is an oval with a decorative motif and a pronged top, while next to it, a larger, irregularly shaped gold and brown object is centered and adorned with a symmetrical black scroll design. To the right of these is an oval brooch featuring a pink and white cameo portrait within a scalloped gold frame. The lower half of the image displays four horizontal bracelets or bands. The first two bands contain repeating round gold and orange segments, with central pieces corresponding to the cameo and an oval pink gem. The third band features consistently sized round gold and orange sections with a rectangular central element. The fourth and final band consists of alternating round gold segments with ornate filigreed designs and features a central square component with a geometric motif, similar to the ornamental pieces above. The colors throughout the drawing are primarily gold, orange, brown, and pink, and every object is outlined and shaded for a dimensional effect. The bottom left corner has small printed text reading "Tollia Westfall."
title: Bracelets
